entities.span: This spec adds a second, independent check on top of every score feature 15 already computes: for each skill the scorer claims matched a listing, a different vendor (Google, already wired in spec 0012) is asked whether that skill is really grounded in the same title and description text the scorer saw.
A skill the check cannot ground is dropped from what a user sees, with a small note, rather than silently kept or silently dropped without explanation.
The check runs on every scored listing that claims at least one skill, in the same wait as the score itself, and its own failure to run is shown, never mistaken for a pass.
